cues.speaker: SS
cues.text: How are you getting on with your art project, Tom?

cues.speaker: OM
cues.text: OK.

cues.speaker: OM
cues.text: Like, they gave us the theme of birds to base our project on, and I'm not really all that

cues.speaker: OM
cues.text: interested in wildlife. But I'm starting to get into it.

cues.speaker: OM
cues.text: I've pretty well finished the introductory stage.

cues.speaker: SS
cues.text: So have I.

cues.speaker: SS
cues.text: When they gave us all those handouts with details of books and websites to look at, I was

cues.speaker: SS
cues.text: really put off, but the more I read, the more interested I got.

cues.speaker: OM
cues.text: Me too.

cues.speaker: OM
cues.text: I found I could research so many different aspects of birds in art – colour, movement,

cues.speaker: OM
cues.text: texture. So I was looking forward to the Bird Park visit.

cues.speaker: SS
cues.text: What a letdown! It poured with rain and we hardly saw a single bird.

cues.speaker: SS
cues.text: Much less use than the trip to the Natural History Museum.

cues.speaker: OM
cues.text: Yeah, I liked all the stuff about evolution there.

cues.speaker: OM
cues.text: The workshop sessions with Dr Fletcher were good too, especially the brainstorming

cues.speaker: OM
cues.text: sessions.

cues.speaker: SS
cues.text: I missed those because I was ill.

cues.speaker: SS
cues.text: I wish we could've seen the projects last year's students did.

cues.speaker: OM
cues.text: Mm. I suppose they want us to do our own thing, not copy.

cues.speaker: OM
cues.text: Yes, but I haven't handed it in. I need to amend some parts.

cues.speaker: OM
cues.text: I've realised the notes from my research are almost all just descriptions, I haven't

cues.speaker: OM
cues.text: actually evaluated anything. So I'll have to fix that.

cues.speaker: SS
cues.text: Oh, I didn't know we had to do that. I'll have to look at that too.

cues.speaker: SS
cues.text: Did you do a timeline for the project?

cues.speaker: SS
cues.text: Yeah, so did I. I quite enjoyed that.

cues.speaker: SS
cues.text: But it was hard having to explain the basis for my decisions in my action plan.

cues.speaker: OM
cues.text: I didn't realise we had to do that. OK, I can add it now.

cues.speaker: OM
cues.text: And I've done the video diary presentation, and worked out what I want my outcome to be

cues.speaker: OM
cues.text: in the project.

cues.speaker: SS
cues.text: Someone told me it's best not to be too precise about your actual outcome at this stage,

cues.speaker: SS
cues.text: so you have more scope to explore your ideas later on.

cues.speaker: SS
cues.text: So I'm going to do back to my proposal to make it a bit more vague.
